==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "EPISODE TITLE" with the appropriate episode name.
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>LightAndMagic|''EPISODE TITLE''}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{LightAndMagic|I Think I Found My People}}</nowiki></code>

Results in: {{LightAndMagic|I Think I Found My People}}
